acf.faq_title: Answers to all your possible questions.

faq_content.faq_question: What are the advantages of using IX gaskets?
faq_content.faq_answer: IX gaskets offer several advantages, including high-pressure sealing capabilities, resistance to corrosion and chemicals, excellent temperature resistance, and compatibility with various flange types and sizes. They also provide a reliable and long-lasting sealing solution for critical applications.

faq_content.faq_question: How do I select the right IX gasket for my application?
faq_content.faq_answer: When selecting an IX gasket, consider factors such as operating pressure, temperature, fluid compatibility, and flange specifications. It is essential to consult with a knowledgeable IX gasket supplier or refer to industry standards to ensure the proper selection that meets your specific application requirements.
IX gaskets are typically designed for single-use applications. Once they have been compressed and used, it is recommended to replace them with new gaskets during reassembly.
